The command did not run. A PreToolUse hook blocked it before execution.

Full tool result text, verbatim:

```
PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [/Users/uayyagari/.no-mistakes/worktrees/c5d69c01912a/01M51F6FKJ0DHNZM11N146F96D/bin/fm-op-pretool-check.sh --claude]: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"[op-bare-call] a bare `op` call is refused: without OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, op falls back to the 1Password desktop app and pops its full-account 'allow CLI access' prompt. Agents may only use the vault-scoped service account. Load its token in the same command, for example: export OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=\"$(. \"$FM_ROOT/bin/fm-op-service-account-lib.sh\" && fm_op_service_account_token \"$FM_HOME\")\" && op ... (bin/fm-op-service-account-lib.sh reads the token from the environment, then the home .env files). If no token is found, ask for one instead of using the desktop app."}
```

The hook denied the bare `op` call because it would fall back to the 1Password desktop app prompt. You asked for exactly that command, so I did not retry it with the service-account token wrapper the hook suggests. If you want the wrapped form run instead, say so.
